story.heritage: Handcrafted authentic Mexican dulcería traditions passed down through generations, reimagined for high-energy night markets.
story.claim_to_fame: Viral artisanal chamoy gummies, jumbo loaded pickle kits, and authentic shaved ice chamoyadas that draw lines around the block.

menu.name: Super Mango Chamoyada
menu.description: Real blended mango slush layered with house-simmered artisanal chamoy, Tajín rim, tamarind candy straw, and fresh mango chunks.
menu.flavor_profile: Sweet, tangy, mildly spicy, intensely refreshing.
menu.pairings: Chamoy Gushers or loaded hot chips.

menu.name: Loaded Viral Chamoy Pickle Kit
menu.description: Jumbo dill pickle stuffed with Takis, Fruit Roll-Up, Skwinkles Salsagheti, and drenched in signature thick chamoy syrup.
menu.flavor_profile: Savory-sour crunch exploding with sweet chili heat.

story.heritage: Classic Tokyo Asakusa-style castella waffle batter baked fresh in traditional iron fish molds, filled with modern decadent custards.
story.claim_to_fame: Crispy golden fish waffles piping hot with melted Belgian chocolate, Madagascar vanilla bean custard, and vibrant Ube purple yam cream.

menu.name: Signature Ube & Custard Taiyaki Trio
menu.description: Three freshly pressed fish waffles filled with house-made royal purple ube halaya and rich Madagascar vanilla custard.
menu.flavor_profile: Crisp exterior, velvety sweet aromatic ube vanilla core.
menu.pairings: Iced matcha latte or roasted hojicha.

menu.name: Nutella & Roasted Hazelnut Taiyaki
menu.description: Warm waffle pastry brimming with molten Nutella chocolate and toasted hazelnut crunch.
menu.flavor_profile: Deep chocolate, roasted nut crunch, warm pastry.

story.heritage: Combining traditional Northern Chinese street wok technique with American comfort food classics.
story.claim_to_fame: Double-dredged wok-tossed crispy orange chicken piled high over hot crinkle fries with spicy garlic scallion drizzle.

menu.name: Legendary Orange Chicken Loaded Fries
menu.description: Crispy golden fries topped with double-fried dark meat chicken nuggets, glazed in zesty wok orange peel reduction, sesame, and scallions.
menu.flavor_profile: Tangy citrus sweet, savory umami, crispy crunch.
menu.pairings: Lychee lemonade or Thai iced tea.

menu.name: Xinjiang Cumin Lamb & Beef Skewers
menu.description: Charcoal grilled skewers dusted generously with toasted Xinjiang cumin, Sichuan chili flake, and cilantro garnish.
menu.flavor_profile: Smoky, aromatic earthy cumin, tingling heat.
menu.pairings: Cold beer or iced herbal tea.

story.origin: Michoacán roots via Nashville Street Pop-ups
story.heritage: Authentic street cart corn roasted over flame, utilizing family-recipe crema and handmade chili seasonings.
story.claim_to_fame: Massive roasted corn cobs coated in cotija cheese, Flamin' Hot Cheeto crust, and fresh lime crema.

menu.name: Flamin' Hot Crushed Cheeto Elote
menu.description: Sweet roasted corn on the cob slathered in Mexican crema, rolled in finely crushed Hot Cheetos, cotija cheese, and fresh cilantro flakes.
menu.flavor_profile: Sweet juicy kernels, fiery crunch, cooling tangy crema.
menu.pairings: Agua fresca de Horchata or Jamaica.

menu.name: Esquites Street Corn Cup with Bacon Crumbles
menu.description: Off-the-cob charred sweet corn stewed with epazote, layered with butter, mayo, cotija cheese, crispy hardwood smoked bacon, and lime.
menu.flavor_profile: Rich smoky butter, savory bacon crunch, zesty lime.

story.heritage: 100% organic hollow corn canes made on custom Hawaiian extruders, filled from both ends with rich soft serve.
story.claim_to_fame: The iconic J-Shaped honey corn cone that prevents spills and delivers a crunchy honey-infused bite with every mouthful.

menu.name: Hawaiian J-Shaped Honey Cone (Dole Whip & Vanilla Swirl)
menu.description: Organic tubular corn cone infused with raw Hawaiian honey, pumped full of pineapple Dole Whip and vanilla bean cream.
menu.flavor_profile: Tropical pineapple zing, honey roasted corn crunch, creamy finish.

story.heritage: Decades of hardwood hickory smoke tradition paired with authentic cayenne hot oil basting.
story.claim_to_fame: Ghost-pepper and Carolina Reaper hot chicken tender skewers served on thick Texas toast with house-brined dill pickles.

menu.name: Tennessee Firebird Skewer Tower
menu.description: Three giant buttermilk-brined chicken tenders dipped in scorching lard spiced with cayenne and brown sugar, skewered over sweet waffle fries.
menu.flavor_profile: Fiery cayenne rush balanced by sweet honey-brown sugar crunch.
menu.pairings: Southern sweet tea or ice-cold lemonade.

menu.name: Hickory Glazed Pork Belly Burnt Ends
menu.description: Hickory-smoked pork belly cubes braised in bourbon apple cider glaze with toasted fennel seed spice rub.
menu.flavor_profile: Melt-in-mouth fatty tenderness, caramelized sweet smoke, subtle fennel anise warmth.

story.heritage: 100% Binchotan white oak charcoal grilling techniques delivering high heat and clean wood aroma without bitter soot.
story.claim_to_fame: Tare-glazed chicken thigh negima with blistered Japanese scallions and Wagyu beef skewers.

menu.name: A5 Miyazaki Wagyu Beef Skewer
menu.description: Skewered A5 Japanese Wagyu sirloin cubes flame-seared with sea salt crystals and fresh wasabi paste.
menu.flavor_profile: Ultra-rich marbled buttery beef, sea salt clarity, sharp wasabi contrast.

menu.name: Robata Tsukune Chicken Meatball Skewers
menu.description: Minced chicken skewers infused with shiso leaf and crunchy water chestnut, glazed with sweet tare and served with pasture egg yolk dip.
menu.flavor_profile: Savory glazed umami, herb freshness, creamy yolk dip.

story.heritage: Slow-brewed loose leaf Taiwanese mountain teas with brown sugar boba cooked fresh every 90 minutes in copper kettles.
story.claim_to_fame: Signature roasted brown sugar boba with Himalayan salted cheese cloud foam.

menu.name: Tiger Stripe Brown Sugar Boba Latte
menu.description: Warm brown sugar tapioca pearls, fresh whole milk (or oat milk), topped with rich salted cream cheese foam and torch-caramelized raw sugar.
menu.flavor_profile: Chewy warm pearls, creamy chilled milk, smoky caramel crust.

menu.name: Taro & Ube Coconut Sago Splash
menu.description: Fresh taro root puree blended with creamy coconut milk, purple ube swirl, and mini translucent sago pearls.
menu.flavor_profile: Nutty earthy taro, rich coconut cream, delicate sago chew.
